concerns.text: FR-003 (Egger's test conditional on N≥10) and SC-002 (I² precision) lack explicit task coverage. T017 (Egger's) and T018 (I²) exist but depend on T014 (Meta-Analysis) which is marked as blocked/rejected in the analyze report. No task explicitly implements the N<10 skip logic for Egger's test as required by FR-003; T017 description mentions skipping but the dependency chain is broken.

FR-005 (Bonferroni correction for k≥2, N≥10) and SC-004 (5+ distinct tracts) are not fully covered. T021 (Correction) exists but depends on T008c (Tract Counter) and T013 (Parser), both of which have broken dependencies per the analyze report. No task explicitly verifies the '5+ distinct tracts' condition required by SC-004 before applying correction.

FR-006 (N<10 pivot to narrative) and SC-005 (narrative summary generation) are partially covered but the gate logic is broken. T057 (Gatekeeper) is marked as rejected/missing in the analyze report, yet T015b (Narrative Engine) and T015d (Pivot) depend on it. Without a functional T057, the pivot mechanism cannot execute as specified.

FR-001 (Extract r, n, tract) and US-1 acceptance scenarios are not fully covered. T013 (Parser) is supposed to handle extraction but depends on T040 (p-value conversion) which is rejected. T040 is also marked as having circular dependencies. No task explicitly covers the extraction of qualitative descriptors for narrative synthesis when (r, n) pairs are missing, as required by FR-001.

Stale tags: T040 is referenced as a dependency in T013 and T014b, but T040 is marked as 'rejected' in the analyze report. This creates a broken dependency chain. The task list should either remove the rejected T040 tag or replace it with a valid implementation task.
